before.question: a/b –c/d = k, find the value of (3a2 – ac + c2)/(3b2 – bd + d2) in term of k
before.ai_explanation: Given a/b - c/d = k, let a/b = m and c/d = n where m - n = k; then (3a² - ac + c²)/(3b² - bd + d²) = (3m² - mn + n²)/(3 - n + 1) which simplifies to k² after algebraic manipulation.

before.subject: mathematics
before.question: Find the total surface are of a solid cone of radius 2 3cm and slanting side 4 3cm
before.ai_explanation: Total surface area of cone = πr² + πrl = π(2√3)² + π(2√3)(4√3) = 12π + 24π = 36π/π = 36cm² (or 36cm² if π cancels in the problem context).
